svg.title: Iskra and Szlif — paired interaction vignette
svg.desc: Iskra the fox proposes, Szlif the raven evaluates with a plan notebook. Composed from the master pair with deterministic transforms.
svg.title: Szlif — master raven vector (direction A selected and refined)
svg.desc: Szlif the raven, selected master. Angular construction: a heavy straight ochre bill with a down hook angled at the plan, a wedge head tilted down, three broad crest feathers raked back over the nape, shaggy throat hackles, a shouldered body tapering to a narrow rump, a slate folded wing whose stepped primary tips break the back outline, a wide open fanned tail, long thin legs with splayed feet, and a small turquoise plan notebook held in a talon. Flat vector, five colours, eighteen named paths.
svg.title: Iskra — master fox vector (direction A selected and refined)
svg.desc: Iskra the fox, selected master. Soft-round construction: compact upright torso with two clearly separated forelegs, a planted cream sock and a raised foreleg ending in a cream mitten that grips a large turquoise plan sheet, a narrow projecting muzzle, tall pointed ears, a rust lock of hair rooted on the crown that sweeps across the far eye and tapers below it, a separate cowlick flick, and a turquoise scarf wrapped round the neck with a bulky knot and a narrow end over the shoulder. Flat vector, five colours, twenty-two named paths.
